caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal scene set against a beige background, featuring a variety of plants, animals, and birds. On the left side, there is a colorful bird with red and green wings perched near green bushes and brown tree trunks with green foliage. A blue bird is flying above, while a white goat with tan spots stands nearby. In front of the goat is a large turtle and what appears to be a small insect. Moving right, a cluster of pink and red flowers with green leaves rises, separated by more green foliage. In the center, large flowers with pink, purple, and deep red petals dominate, flanked by curling green stems and additional leafy plants. To the right, blue flowers appear at the base, with another large bird, yellow and brown, flying above, and a small orange fox-like animal runs on the ground below. Round pink objects, possibly flowers or fruit, are scattered near the bottom right, and a tall green bush or small tree stands at the far right edge. Throughout the image, the ground is indicated by a green hilly line with faint darker green shading, and various smaller details include additional floral and insect shapes scattered between the main subjects.
title: Section of Crewel Embroidery on Border of Petticoat
